A great experience but ask for help when ordering.
Jul 2024 • Friends
Two of us came back to the Barbecue Garden with friends we are traveling with, 10 years after our previous visit. The food was lovely but I would like to caution anyone going for first time about choosing from the menu. It isn’t entirely clear from pictures/descriptions on menu, what meat comes as skewers and what as a plate of marinated meat. So do ask for specific clarification. We over ordered! We also were keen to do our own cooking but staff seemed to come and turn meat immediately after we had, and did not seem to understand that we were happy to cook ourselves. Also, probably should have more than one set of tongs, in this day and age, to prevent cross contamination between seafood, beef and chicken. Surprisingly, in this location, and with a lot of tourists, staff were not strong with English but they were friendly and when we needed to cancel some of the order, were accommodating. Do order a Mocktail for the sheer experience. They came in huge glasses and were superb! (I’m presuming the cocktails do also.)
Overall, an enjoyable meal but some work on the menu or explanation of how to order, by the staff, would be a suggestion to management.
